title: Tampal Lagi
subject: a pothole outside the market patched three times in one month, each time the night before an official visit
caption: Boria, the Penang satirical chorus song, in a brisk stage-show style. A violin playing a bright march-like melody and answering the lead, an accordion pumping chords on the offbeats, gendang drums driving a 2/4 march pulse, and tambourine and maracas shaking on every beat. Bright and brisk, an open-air stage sound, the chorus wide and loud, the lead vocal forward and dry. Male lead with northern Penang Malay colour, comic and topical, half-sung and half-declaimed, and a uniformed male chorus answering in tight unison. 126 BPM, G major. Deadpan satire, marching and grinning. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no synths, no autotune, no slow ballad section, no dikir barat seated clapping.
lyrics:
[Intro - violin march melody and gendang roll]

[Verse 1]
Depan pasar ikan ada satu lubang besar
Hujan sikit jadi kolam, ikan keli pun boleh mandi
Isnin malam lori mai, tampal, siap pasang kon
Selasa pagi YB mai, gunting reben, ambik gambar

[Chorus]
Tampal lagi! (Tampal lagi!)
YB mai, jalan licin, YB balik, lubang mai
Tampal lagi! (Tampal lagi!)
Lubang ni lagi setia dari kucing aku

[Verse 2]
Rabu hujan turun, tar tu terkopek habis
Mak Cik Kiah naik motor, terhenjut, kangkung bertabur
Khamis malam lori mai, tampal lagi, lagi tebal
Jumaat pagi menteri mai - hang tak payah habaq, kami tau dah

[Bridge - chorus in unison with hand claps, violin stops]
Satu, dua, tiga kali dah! (Tiga kali!)
Lain kali bawa menteri tiap-tiap minggu! (Tiap-tiap minggu!)

[Chorus]
Tampal lagi! (Tampal lagi!)
YB mai, jalan licin, YB balik, lubang mai
Tampal lagi! (Tampal lagi!)
Lubang ni dah ada pangkat, kami panggil dia Datuk

[Outro - violin march to a stop, chorus shout]
Hidup lubang! (Hidup!)
Jumpa minggu depan!
